title: FNB Wines2Whales
summary: Three days of mountain bike stage racing from the winelands to the coast in the Overberg, expected in November 2027. The 2026 race week ran from 6 to 15 November 2026; riders can join the early-bird priority list for 2027 entries, and no dates are published yet.
description: Three days of mountain biking from wines to the coast! 3 days, 189 km, 3,850 m of climbing. The FNB Wines2Whales offers three events, the Chardonnay, Pinotage and Shiraz, and the Pinotage hosts two dedicated E-Bike events. The 2026 race week ran from 6 to 15 November 2026 and sold out fast. Join the GEES Early Bird Priority List and get exclusive early access to 2027 race entries before they're released to the general public.
profile: The FNB Wines2Whales is a three-day, 189 km mountain bike stage race through the Overberg from the winelands to the coast, with three events and e-bike categories. The 2026 race week ran in November, and the 2027 edition is expected in November, with entries opening first to riders on the early-bird list. It suits mountain bikers who want a sociable stage race through wine farms and coastal trails.
